description: This file defines the class kintVariableData, which models variable data for debugging or dumping purposes, including properties like type, access, name, value, and helper methods for encoding detection and string manipulation.

classes.name: kintVariableData
classes.description: A data structure class used for representing debugging variable information, with helpers for encoding detection, array sequencing, and string handling.

methods.name: _detectEncoding
methods.description: Detects the character encoding of a string using mb_detect_encoding or falls back to default.

methods.name: _isSequential
methods.description: Determines if a given array is a sequential array starting from zero.

methods.name: _strlen
methods.description: Returns the string length considering multi-byte encodings.

methods.name: _substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of a string, supporting multi-byte encodings.
